{{Quote|Its capital city of Salis D'aar is conveniently laid out in a circular pattern, making it easy for outsiders to navigate.|Eloc Throno, ''Traveler's Guide to Batuu''|<ref name="TGTB" />}}
'''Salis D'aar''' was the [[capital]] [[city]] of the [[planet]] [[Bakura]]. It was laid out in a circular pattern which, according to [[historian]] [[Eloc Throno]] in his<ref name="TGTB" /> [[34 ABY]]<ref name="TGDate">{{TravelersGuidetoBatuuDate}}</ref> [[book]] ''[[Traveler's Guide to Batuu]]'', made it easy for outsiders and visitors to navigate. Throno also wrote in the book that Salis D'aar was a large city located within a reasonable commute from the planet [[Batuu]], and that it could offer all modern conveniences needed.<ref name="TGTB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Salis D'aar was first mentioned in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2020]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Traveler's Guide to Batuu]]'', written by [[Cole Horton]].<ref name="TGTB" /> [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]] was originally introduced in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in the [[1993]] novel ''[[The Truce at Bakura]]'', written by [[Kathy Tyers]].<ref name="Truce">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>
